files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Changed
- App drawer closes automatically after navigation on mobile
- Reordering of tracks by dragging is enabled on mobile
- Bumped front-end and PHP dependencies

### Fixed
- Reordering of tracks by dragging now works on Firefox
